intro.value: A premium lifestyle brand offering luxury fragrances, home décor, and body care products crafted for the intentional woman and the discerning home. CNM Essentials is the fragrance and lifestyle destination for those who believe that how you live at home reflects who you are in the world.

philosophy.brand: Purpose-crafted luxury for modern living — combining natural ingredients, artisanal quality, and a deep sense of intentionality that transforms everyday rituals into meaningful experiences.

roots.value: Part of CNM Group — a privately held, founder-led conglomerate headquartered in Lagos, Nigeria, with operations spanning Abuja and the United States.

mission.value: To build and grow businesses that consistently deliver outstanding value, improve everyday experiences, and earn the trust of customers and partners through quality, innovation, and responsible leadership.

vision.value: To become one of Africa's most respected diversified business groups, recognized globally for excellence, innovation, and sustainable growth.
